summary.name: 讯飞星火 (iFlytek Spark)
summary.one_liner: iFlytek's Spark (讯飞星火) is a Chinese cognitive large language model and AI assistant offering chat, writing, Q&A, image generation, document reading, PPT, code and meeting-notes tools, plus APIs for developers.
use_cases: Asking general knowledge questions and getting quick answers
Summarizing long documents and extracting key points
Transcribing and summarizing meetings or recordings
Building AI features into products via API
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Spark as a general-purpose AI assistant covering knowledge Q&A, content writing, text-to-image generation, document Q&A, PPT generation, code writing and debugging, recording-to-minutes transcription, and photo-based problem solving. It also lists a deep research feature and resume/interview coaching. For developers, it offers a Spark API with deep reasoning models, scenario-specific APIs and model fine-tuning, including Spark-X2.6 and smaller 4B and 1.7B lightweight models. A set of named products (e.g., 讯飞绘文, 讯飞智文, 星火纪要, 星火投标) built on the model for enterprise office tasks and video creation is also listed. The page is mostly promotional, with customer showcases and no detailed technical specifications.
notable: Spark API with deep reasoning, scenario-specific APIs and model fine-tuning toolchain
Lightweight on-device Spark-X2.6-4B and Spark-X2.5-1.7B models
Suite of enterprise tools including 星火纪要 meeting summaries and 星火投标 bid writing
Photo problem solving that explains solution approaches
caveats: Pricing and free-tier limits are not stated on the page
Content is in Chinese; the page does not describe English-language support
Much of the page is promotional customer showcases rather than technical detail
